homepage.title: Learn English with Cedar
homepage.subtitle: Supporting every learner in acquiring English to succeed in their studies, career and international environment.
homepage.aboutCardText: Cedar Training Center helps learners develop English language skills for studies, career growth and integration in international contexts.
homepage.programCardText: General English, Business English, IELTS/TOEFL/TOEIC preparation, workshops and personalized intensive tracks.

about.title: A center dedicated to English learning
about.intro: Cedar Training Center is dedicated to English language teaching. We help learners develop their language skills to succeed in their studies, career and integration in an international environment.
about.missionText: Offer quality English training that allows learners to communicate with confidence and effectiveness in professional and academic environments.
about.visionText: Become a reference centre in language training, recognized for excellence, innovation and impact.
about.methodText: Dynamic courses, real-life scenarios, intensive speaking practice and individual support to guarantee measurable progress at every level.

courses.title: Training tracks at Cedar
courses.intro: Our programs are designed for practical communication and measurable progression.
